messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call: Security & compliance discovery (SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA) - next steps

Hi Sam / Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary of the call:
- Scope: You're evaluating Redwood for customer-facing chat + embeddings (PII redaction will be applied on your side). Primary concerns: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, and vendor questionnaire turnaround.
- Current environment: FinCo will host EU-facing traffic in their EU region; some US processing for analytics.
- Must-haves: SOC 2 Type II evidence (or attestation timeline), data residency guarantees for EU data, contractual DPA/GDPR terms, and evidence of encryption-at-rest and in-transit.

Action items / next steps:
1) I attached our high-level Security Overview (Redwood_Security_Overview_2027.pdf) — includes current certifications in progress and controls mapping.
2) Please start the vendor security questionnaire (I see you have SQ-123) — I'll assign our security team to support any clarifications.
3) We will share SOC 2 status: Redwood is currently undergoing our SOC 2 Type II audit with ClearSight; expected report delivery Q3 2027. We can provide a bridge letter and our controls narrative in the meantime.
4) Proposed follow-up: 30-min technical call next week to walk your security team through encryption, key management, and our DPA. Lauren (CC'd) can join for answers on scope/roadmap.

Questions I promised to confirm:
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support contractual DPA and will sign reasonable BAAs for covered workflows; we operate optional private deployments for stricter environments.
- FedRAMP / ISO: ISO 27001 assessment and FedRAMP alignment are on our roadmap — ISO evaluation slated for Q4 2027; FedRAMP is a longer-term priority.

Attach: Redwood_Security_Overview_2027.pdf

Thanks — let me know the best time for the technical call and the primary contact for the questionnaire.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & compliance discovery (SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA) - next steps

Sam —

Thanks — answers inline below and attaching a provisional bridge artifact.

Q: Customer-managed keys?
A: We support both: for hosted customers we offer Redwood-managed KMS keys by default (AES-256 at rest + TLS 1.3 in transit). For customers that require BYOK, we support customer-managed keys via integrations with AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault in our Dedicated and Private deployment options. We'll provide an implementation note on key rotation and access controls.

Q: EU data residency guarantee?
A: Yes — we can commit to routing and storing EU-labeled data in EU regions for hosted deployments. For stronger contractual guarantees and isolated tenancy we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment; we'll include specific DPA language.

Q: SOC 2 bridge / interim evidence?
A: Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2027.pdf and a controls narrative excerpt. As mentioned, full SOC 2 Type II report is expected Q3 2027 (audit performed by ClearSight).

Roadmap / certifications: 
- SOC 2: In progress (Type II) — target completion Q3 2027.
- ISO 27001: Gap assessment complete; formal audit planned for Q4 2027.
- FedRAMP: exploratory roadmap; multi-year program depending on momentum from regulated customers.

Next step proposal: 30-min technical call with your security team + our Security Engineer (Rishi) and Lauren (Head of Product) — available Tue 2027-05-04 14:00-16:00 PDT or Thu 2027-05-06 13:00-15:00 PDT. Which slot works?

Attach: Redwood_SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2027.pdf

Best,
Marissa
